verdict.rationale: Oyster is a hosted global-employment SaaS with a public API. Asking whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a source repository, an open-source license, or public code, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
